extraction_notes: The datasheet covers SS52 through SS520; shared curves were retained only where the plotted series explicitly includes SS520.

Fig. 3 SS515-SS520 and Fig. 4 SS58-SS520 traces are grouped curves rather than SS520-only traces; points are approximate digitizations of the plotted target-containing trace, not guaranteed electrical limits.
Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 are shared datasheet curves applicable to SS520; plotted points are approximate digitizations.

For SS520, maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage and maximum DC blocking voltage are each 200 V at Ta=25°C. These are not mapped to breakdown_voltage because the datasheet does not specify breakdown voltage.

The electrical-characteristics table also specifies maximum reverse current IR2=5 mA at VR=VDC and TA=100°C for SS520; reverse_current records the 25°C IR1 value because the schema permits one scalar.
Polarity marking: the cathode line denotes the cathode end. Forward curves use forward-bias polarity and reverse curves use reverse-bias polarity.
